candidate_name: GRTgaz Antifer (Saint-Jouin-Bruneval) LNG import capacity study
sponsor_or_proposer: GRTgaz (French gas transmission system operator) -- opportunity study only, no project developer/owner identified
current_state: GRTgaz's March 2023 ten-year transmission network development plan disclosed 'etudes d'opportunite' (opportunity/feasibility studies) for three possible new LNG import projects to expand Le Havre-area capacity: two onshore terminals and one floating unit, the floating option potentially moored at the port of Antifer, Saint-Jouin-Bruneval (Seine-Maritime) -- the same site as GEM's cancelled Le Havre-Antifer LNG Terminal (T100000130454). Reporting (Disclose.ngo investigative piece, corroborated by a Greenpeace France briefing) states the local mayor had never been consulted or informed, and no subsequent 2024-2026 update, sponsor announcement, permit filing, or CNDP public-debate process was found.
missing_threshold_elements: No named project sponsor/developer (GRTgaz is the network operator studying system needs, not a terminal owner); no confirmed site (mooring location described only as a possibility); no capacity, cost, or schedule figures; no regulatory filing or public-debate process opened.
watch_for: A named developer/operator taking over the Antifer floating-unit concept; a CNDP public-debate filing or environmental review for a new Antifer/Le Havre project; GRTgaz's next ten-year plan update (typically biennial) confirming or dropping the study; any capacity-allocation tender referencing a second Le Havre-area import point.
notes: Corroborating source: https://cdn.greenpeace.fr/site/uploads/2023/06/Rapport_terminal_methanier_flottant.pdf (Greenpeace France briefing citing the same GRTgaz ten-year-plan opportunity studies). Both URLs verified via url_verifier.py against token 'Antifer' (PASS). Distinct from the original Gaz de Normandie/Poweo-CIM sponsor behind the cancelled GEM record -- no evidence that sponsor is still active at this site (its most recent public statement found predates the 2013 cancellation). If a real sponsor later steps forward at Antifer, this would be a dead-and-revived case (different sponsor + different design -- floating vs. the original onshore proposal) per the Discovery SOP, staged as a NEW terminal with AssociatedTerminals -> T100000130454, not an edit to the dead record.
